source_inventory.summary: EN directive 'Anti-AI-Slop Writing Directive v2' with no license or author. Contents: 11 structural rules (lines 14-38), 5 punctuation rules with thresholds (40-50), 10 'What To Do Instead' rules with 6 'X beats Y' few-shot pairs (52-72), 4 accuracy rules with 2 pairs (74-82), 6 formatting rules (84-96), voice calibration with 4 questions and a default (98-106), an 11-item self-check (108-120), and a silent-application rule (122). Line 12 links to references/banned-words.md, which is MISSING.

PT-BR skill v1.7.0, Apache 2.0, author https://ft.ia.br. Contents: TRAVA FACTUAL plus 6 protections (27-36), 6-item triage (38-47), 4 modes (49-62), inventory and questions (64-80), 12 voice profiles with examples (82-409), shared rules for the fast-reading profiles (411-430), modo_criacao (432-451). The 9-step process: detection table with 14 rows, diagnosis table with 28 rows, router with 8 rows, specificity table with 5 rows, voice table with 13 rows, false-positive tables with 25 and 8 rows, verification tables with 12 and 6 rows, scoring, and the attempt-loop pseudo-code (453-748). Also: output contract YAML (750-787), loop YAML (789-802), 43 preserved anglicisms (804-812), regression suite T1-T8 (814-831), optional Jev section (835-902). Links to the sister skill human-ai, which is NOT in the pack.

7 content patterns: emphasis, notability, gerund analysis, promotional language, vague attribution, formulaic conclusions, invented source. Totals: 70 trigger items, 7 Antes/Depois pairs, 21 Evitar lines, 6 named tests (jornalista, verificabilidade 30 s, podcast, pitch deck, fonte 2 min, horóscopo), and the '[⚠️ VERIFICAR FONTE]' marker.

9 language patterns. #1 AI vocabulary: 38 triggers and 14 substitution lines. #9 syntactic calques: 10 triggers, 12 substitutions, 3 alternatives, 1 note. 9 pairs in total, plus 'correção segura' notes on #4 and #6. The header mentions an external 'skill original'.

14 tone patterns, from servile tone (#1) to máxima de camiseta (#14). About 81 triggers, 14 pairs, 43 Evitar lines, 2 'correção segura' notes, 1 'variação por perfil' note. #14 adds 4 signals and 4 techniques.

10 composition tropes and 3 semantic-ablation patterns, with 13 pairs and 44 Evitar lines. Alternativa falsa has 7 triggers. Numeric thresholds: metaphor more than 2 per text, more than 1 per paragraph, or in more than 3 paragraphs in a row; more than 2 analogies; dilution across more than 3 paragraphs; concreteness scale 1-5 with mean below 2. Also: 4 closing options, 3 Restaurar lists. Attribution: tropes.fyi and The Register (Feb 2026).

11 style and punctuation patterns: travessão, negrito, bold-label lists, Title Case, emojis, curly quotes, Unicode decoration, dramatic fragments, Oxford comma, period and quotes, minimise-then-inflate. 11 pairs. The curly-quote pair is DEGENERATE: Antes equals Depois because the curly quotes were normalised. Em-dash thresholds: AI 15-25 per text vs humans 2-3; more than 10% of punctuation; at most 2 per paragraph; mandatory sweep; 3 exceptions.

12 PT-BR-only patterns in 13 subsections, from gerundismo to analytic passive voice. Totals: 111 triggers, 98 Evitar lines, 68 Alternativas, 13 pairs. Also a 12-row quick checklist with the rule '3+ padrões = alta probabilidade' and a context note listing 5 domains. The header mentions 'skill humanizer original em inglês'.

Reference for the Português Simplificado profile, based on PorSimples, Lei 15.263/2025 and NILC-Metrix. Contents: 7 operations with 12 Antes and 11 Depois; lexical tables with 13, 15, 14 and 8 rows; metric tables (ASL ~20/16/13, phrase classes, TTR 0.19/0.17/0.16, 6 syntactic indicators); rules R1-R15; 4 domain pairs; the conflict-marker code block; a 5-row TRAVA table; a 7-row profile comparison; a 12-item checklist. External refs carry licences (CC BY 4.0, AGPL-3.0).

Assertivo, Enxuto and Resumo profiles. Selection table and quick rule. Formatting tables (markers, bold, emoji states). Resumo template code block. Cut, reposition and never-cut tables plus the master rule. Patterns that still apply and patterns suspended. CORRETO/ERRADO and pseudo-python code blocks. A 6-row brevity check, an exact duplicate of SKILL.md. 3 pairs with word counts (87 to 52, 54 to 12, 62 to 58). Consumption-vs-authorial table and a 14-item checklist.

5-field inventory table; rules for notes and transcripts; gap questions (at most 3, one round, one example question); two-way audit; table of 6 invalid changes; provenance note (phuryn/work-humanizer, commit 0a9065791d021f3dda695f3887cb2ae4c0eacbcf).

Optional TypeSafe Jev evaluation: what Jev is ($0.042/M input tokens, 70-500 ms), a comparison table, discovery order, 4 detection steps, 5 per-harness blocks (14 fenced code blocks in total), question-format tables, JSON request and response, interpretation (P at least 0.5; limiar 80), a decisions table, external refs. Its counts are wrong (category table sums to 57 but says 52). It references scripts/jev_eval.py, which does NOT exist.

Jev question bank v1.0.0: 67 questions. 63 are Noul (57 diagnosis split composicao 9 / tom 14 / linguagem 9 / conteudo 7 / estilo 10 / ptbr 8, plus 2 falso_positivo and 4 verificacao marked critical). 4 are Score (weights 35/30/20/15). Its metadata block is stale (says 52 Noul). Data only, nothing executes it.

English UI copy ban list: 8 lines with 11 terms (Unleash / Unlock, Supercharge, Elevate, Seamless / Seamlessly, Leverage, Dive In, Tapestry, Next-generation / Next-level), plus a ban on em dashes in headings and body. Used only to seed the English banned list; the anti-slop target keeps its own copy.

### Comprimento de frase (no 3 consecutive sentences of the same length; mix short and long; Português simplificado cap of 25 prevails)
### Parataxe (connect 3+ short declaratives with subordination or punctuation; translated example; profile exemptions)

frontmatter_description_draft: Escreve e reescreve texto em português brasileiro (e em inglês, com lista própria) sem marcas de escrita de IA, preservando fatos, números, fontes, modalidade e argumento. Use para tirar cara de IA, remover AI slop, dar voz, humanização de texto, linguagem simples, revisão anti-IA e para escrever do zero qualquer texto que alguém vai assinar ou publicar: post de LinkedIn, tweet, thread, e-mail, artigo, proposta, release, README, bio, legenda, carta de apresentação, relatório, descrição de produto, mensagem de WhatsApp ou Slack, status update. Aciona com pedidos como escreva, redija, reescreva, deixe mais humano, sem cara de ChatGPT, anti-slop, simplifique, direto ao ponto, resumo de status, e com pedidos em inglês como write, draft, rewrite, make this sound human, not AI. Aplica perfis de voz (crônica, jornalístico, acadêmico, jurídico, didático, assertivo, enxuto, resumo e outros), vocabulário proibido, regras de estrutura e pontuação, guarda de falso positivo e trava factual.

# Anti-AI-slop: escrita em português brasileiro (one line of scope; never promise a detector result)
## Escopo e idioma: PT-BR by default; English text uses the core rules plus references/vocabulario-banido.md sections B-D; mixed text is handled segment by segment and other languages are preserved

## Proteções obrigatórias: canonical TRAVA FACTUAL (full list of protected elements) plus concreteness without invention, argument kept, register kept, precision before style, no dumbing down; markers [DADO OU EXEMPLO REAL NECESSÁRIO]; protections prevail over examples
## Triagem obrigatória: 6 items (critical-safety texts, normative legal texts, bilingual exact match, protected technical spans, out-of-scope handling)
## Modos de operação: 4-row table (3/1/3/2 attempts); 5+ severe signals selects modo_revisão; more than 500 words means work in semantic blocks
## Inventário e perguntas: two-way inventory; at most 3 questions in one round; none in modo_direto; link references/auditoria-entrega.md

## Regras de escrita limpa > Estrutura: rule of three (by mode), no 3 consecutive same-length sentences, parataxis (by profile), hedging (by mode), no pep talk, no identical paragraph shape, at most 5 bullets in a row, no 'Como [cargo], eu...' opener in creation, vary sections, passive only when the agent is unknown, let paragraphs end

## Regras de escrita limpa > Pontuação: replace every aside em dash or en dash; at most 1 exclamation per 1,000 words; ellipsis at most 1 per text; use semicolons; colons must deliver; PT-BR conventions (Oxford comma, period outside quotes, straight quotes); link padroes-estilo.md

## Regras de escrita limpa > Formatação por canal: no markdown in e-mail, DM or SMS; no headers in social, e-mail or casual text; 0-2 hashtags; no 🧵 / Fio / Thread openers; no emoji bullets (Resumo exempt)

## Regras de escrita limpa > Especificidade sem invenção: be specific, show, give numbers, name real things, give time and place, add friction ONLY from source or user material; never invent anecdotes, data or quotes; mark hypotheses with 'Suponha que'; never use a listed banned word in text you generate
## Regras de escrita limpa > Aplicação silenciosa: never mention the rules in the delivered text; never claim a check you did not run

## Escrita do zero (modo_criacao): 5 steps; scan first for the 5 priority patterns (aside em dash, 'não apenas X, mas também Y', connective opening a paragraph, forced triad, generic optimistic close); TRAVA in creation; deliver only the text
